purpose: New close camera shots for the whole Trial by Puffer gameplay rework

prompts.name: evidence
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. This is an edit of the reference Councillion underwater courtroom environment into a new camera shot for its survival trivia game. Preserve the reference's deliberately drawn 16-bit pixel-art language, limited navy/teal/plum/cream/gold palette, crisp stepped silhouettes, submerged law-court stonework and warm small lanterns. It must read as a cohesive game background, never photorealistic, painted or 3D. Wide 16:9 game scene, approximately 480x270 logical pixel detail rendered sharply at high resolution. No characters, no lettering, no fake text, no UI, no labels, no grids of cards, no dice, no chalices painted into the center. Keep the central upper 30–48% of the image dark and uncluttered for question text, and the lower 82–100% as visible stone floor for six player sprites. No bloom, depth-of-field or excessive clutter. Camera shot: closer view of the evidence desk in the archive. A broad low stone desk with a dark matte walnut work surface spans x15–85%, with its back edge at y50% and front edge at y78%. Its middle is completely empty, a generous dark workspace for interactive evidence icons. An empty central arch and receding law-library shelves behind it, small closed books and a quill ONLY on far desk edges. A few coral tufts at the sides, pale aqua light from above, discreet gold laurels carved into the desk front. The scene should feel tactile and calm before a memory challenge.
